title: Adopt fractal `control.v0` envelope, `--view brief|delta|frontier|full`, and zero-prose `refs.handoff` capsules
description:
Every workflow command in `cmdrvl` projects into the shared `evidence-protocol` `control.v0` envelope so agents use one uniform grammar from local checks up to portfolio runs.

Capabilities:
- `--view brief` (default, <= ~500 tokens): verdict, `boundary`, `coverage`, top-K `unknowns[]`, `budget`, `refs{}`, typed `next_actions[]`.
- `--view delta --since <prev_ref>` (<= ~300 tokens): turn-over-turn diff showing only newly resolved items, new regressions, remaining blockers, and budget delta.
- `--view frontier`: cursor-paginated slice of only answer-changing unknowns.
- `refs.handoff` + `cmdrvl handoff load <ref> --json`: content-addressed handoff capsule pinning inputs, boundary posture, and frontier cursor with hash drift detection for lossless multi-agent handoff after compaction.
acceptance_criteria:
- Consumes `control.v0` directly from `cmdrvl/evidence-protocol` (no forked schema).
- `--view delta --since <prev_ref>` deterministically computes resolved/regressed deltas and cuts output size >= 5x on iterative runs.
- `cmdrvl handoff load <ref>` verifies underlying input hashes and refuses with structured `E_HANDOFF_DRIFT` if inputs mutated.

title: Bootstrap cmdrvl Rust crate, CLI skeleton, spine-rules conformance, and operator.v1 manifest
description:
Stand up the `cmdrvl` binary crate (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, Rust edition 2024, clap derive CLI) with strict `spine-rules` conformance:
- Exit code trinity (`0` clean, `1` domain-negative, `2` structured refusal)
- Embedded `operator.json` (`operator.v0`) with byte-equal `--describe`, `--schema`, `--version`
- Read-only agent discovery surfaces: `--robot-triage`, `capabilities --json`, `robot-docs guide`, `doctor health --json`
- CI workflow (fmt, clippy, test) and release/Homebrew formula template matching other spine repos.
acceptance_criteria:
- `cargo test` passes including `spine-rules::golden_rules_suite!`.
- `cmdrvl --describe`, `cmdrvl --schema`, `cmdrvl capabilities --json`, `cmdrvl robot-docs guide`, and `cmdrvl --robot-triage` exit 0 with zero side effects.
notes:
2026-11-24 Alignment Note: `spine-rules` (`b18c216`) landed strict `operator.v1` (`schema_version`, `tool_version`, `commands`, `refusals`) and `cmdrvl.doctor.v1`. Target `operator.v1` and `cmdrvl.doctor.v1` directly.
2026-11-25 Plugin Dispatch Decision (Option 1): Support git/cargo-style external subcommand dispatch via clap allow_external_subcommands(true): any unknown subcommand `cmdrvl <name> [args...]` resolves `cmdrvl-<name>` on PATH (rejecting path separators or invalid names), propagates exit status verbatim, and never allows external plugins to shadow built-in subcommands. If no `cmdrvl-<name>` exists on PATH, emit a deterministic exit-2 refusal.

title: Implement `cmdrvl orient --json` & fleet doctor: one-call cold-start posture, fleet health, active state, and typed next_actions
description:
A cold agent should never run 14 experimental `--version` / `doctor` probes to understand its workspace.

Implement `cmdrvl orient --json` (read-only, bounded <= ~500 tokens by default) returning:
1. `boundary`: live posture from `veil` / `airlock` (`enforcement`, `twin_mode`, `attestation_mode`, `local_reads`, `violations`, protected path/DB roots)
2. `fleet`: installed spine binaries, semver/digests, health status, available frozen profiles, fingerprints, registries, and strategy champions
3. `active_state`: running `twinning` instances, open `canon entity` sessions, in-flight runs, and witness tail hash
4. `next_actions[]`: ranked, typed actions with `effect_class` (`pure_read | twin_exec | broker_exec | local_write | external_io | irreversible_promote`) and structured `invocation {bin, argv}`.
acceptance_criteria:
- `cmdrvl orient --json` executes read-only in <250ms, never leaks secrets, and stays within ~500 tokens in `--view brief`.
- Degrades gracefully when optional tools (`veil`, `airlock`, `twinning`, `em`) are not installed, surfacing exact install/repair `next_actions[]`.
- Integration tests cover clean workspace, missing tools, active `veil` sandbox posture, and running `twinning` instance.
notes: 2026-11-25 Plugin Discovery: `cmdrvl orient --json` should also enumerate installed external `cmdrvl-*` subcommand plugins found on PATH (name + resolved path, querying `--describe` if available) so agents see both built-in and extension commands in one call.

title: Implement `cmdrvl receipt` (atomic cancel-safe sealing), `cmdrvl twin`, and `cmdrvl sandbox --twin --egress airlock`
description:
Build the Tier 2 local orchestration layer on `asupersync`:
- `cmdrvl receipt <OLD> <NEW> --out <DIR>`: runs `vacuum`/`hashbytes`/`lock`/`shape`/`rvl`/`verify`/`assess` as a region-owned DAG with algebraic budgets and cancel-safe two-phase `pack seal` + `pack verify` (no partial packs or orphan witnesses on Ctrl-C/timeout).
- `cmdrvl twin up|status|diff|down`: ergonomic wrapper over `twinning --port 0 --overlay-of <snapshot>` projecting into `control.v0 --view brief|delta`.
- `cmdrvl sandbox [--twin] [--egress airlock] -- <agent>`: unified Tier 2 sealed workstation launcher delegating to `veil sandbox` + `airlock gate --mode policy-proxy` + `twinning`.
acceptance_criteria:
- Mid-flight cancellation during `cmdrvl receipt` drains cleanly to quiescence and leaves zero partial packs or corrupted witness lines.
- `cmdrvl twin up --port 0` emits a machine-readable readiness packet and cleans up cleanly on teardown.
- E2E integration test verifies `cmdrvl receipt` produces an offline-verifiable `pack verify` bundle.
notes:
2026-11-24 update: expose `cmdrvl report <pack>` (delegating to `pack render`) and `cmdrvl history` (delegating to `pack index`/`pack query`) for executive audit dossiers and local longitudinal pack recall.
2026-11-25 Runtime Scope Update: Do NOT mandate asupersync for cmdrvl porcelain or twinning. Keep cmdrvl lightweight and runtime-agnostic — enforce atomic, cancel-safe two-phase pack sealing (temp dir + atomic rename + clean SIGINT/timeout teardown) without pulling an unnecessary async runtime.

title: Add cross-repo E2E integration CI harness running real spine binaries on messy CSV/XLSX/Parquet fixtures
description:
## Background (Fresh-Eyes Architecture Audit)
Every `cmdrvl` repo currently tests itself in isolation with synthetic fixtures. Cross-tool seam bugs (`verify --lock` expecting `lock.input.v1`, `benchmark --lock` rejecting `blake3:`, `airlock` `messages[1].content` object format, `veil` `--explicit` flag gaps) slip past 16 green per-repo CIs.

## Scope
Add a cross-repo E2E integration harness and scheduled/workflow-dispatch GitHub Actions job in `cmdrvl/cmdrvl` that builds/installs the real spine binaries and runs the 3 canonical end-to-end pipelines on realistic messy CSV, XLSX, and Parquet fixtures:
1. **Tabular Spine Proof:** `vacuum` -> `hashbytes --algorithm blake3` -> `lock` -> `lock verify` -> `fingerprint` -> `profile` -> `shape` -> `rvl` (numeric + `--non-numeric`) -> `verify --lock` -> `assess` -> `pack seal` -> `pack verify` -> `pack render`.
2. **Boundary Plane Proof:** `veil` + `airlock` + `boundary-detectors` (verifying zero raw canary leakage across `veil`-authorized spine tools, `--explicit` flag denial, and `airlock gate` policy-proxy blocking/streaming).
3. **Twin Plane Proof:** `twinning --port 0` + `verify` + `pack seal` / `pack verify`.
acceptance_criteria:
- Runnable E2E harness script/suite executes real compiled binaries end-to-end across all 3 canonical pipelines.
- Asserts zero canary raw-cell leakage in default (redacted) outputs, `lock.v0` (`blake3:` + `sha256:`) interoperability across `lock`/`verify`/`benchmark`, and `pack verify` exit 0.
- Wired into `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` (nightly + `workflow_dispatch`).

title: Implement zero-retention local workflows: `cmdrvl inspect`, `cmdrvl diff` (shape->rvl), `cmdrvl check` (verify), and `--emit-inquiry`
description:
Provide zero-ceremony, redacted-by-default porcelain over the pure synchronous spine leaves:
- `cmdrvl inspect <FILE>` (CSV, TSV, JSONL, Parquet, XLSX): structural/schema summary without raw cell leakage.
- `cmdrvl diff <OLD> <NEW> [--key K] [--profile P]`: enforces `shape` comparability gate before `rvl`, surfaces mechanical refusal recovery (`E_NEED_KEY`), and projects into `control.v0`.
- `cmdrvl check <FILE> --rules <RULES>`: runs `verify` and projects violations into `control.v0` with `--view brief|delta`.
- `--emit-inquiry <PATH>`: escalates any local workflow cleanly into an `evidence-protocol` `inquiry.v0` for higher-order runtimes.
acceptance_criteria:
- `cmdrvl diff` refuses to run `rvl` when `shape` exits `1` (INCOMPATIBLE) and emits a structured `control.v0` verdict with `refs`.
- Default output never exposes raw cell values (`--explicit` requires explicit flag and respects `veil` boundary posture).
- `--emit-inquiry` produces schema-valid `inquiry.v0` validated against `evidence-protocol` fixtures.
notes: 2026-11-24 update: expose `cmdrvl diff --non-numeric` wiring `rvl`'s domain-agnostic non-numeric comparison mode (`date_shifts`, `categorical_transitions`, `nullity_flips`, `text_churn`, `row_churn`) into the `control.v0` brief/delta projection.

title: cmdrvl v0: unified porcelain CLI front door & fractal control.v0 runner
description:
Implement the unified `cmdrvl` porcelain CLI and local workflow runner specified in `docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

Goal: give AI coding agents one cold-start orientation call (`cmdrvl orient --json`), one token-bounded fractal control grammar (`control.v0` with `--view brief|delta|frontier|full`, `boundary` posture, typed `effect_class` `next_actions[]`, and `refs.handoff`), and zero-ceremony composition over the pure synchronous spine leaves (`shape`, `rvl`, `verify`, `profile`, `assess`, `pack`, `veil`, `airlock`, `twinning`), running local multi-step DAGs on Asupersync with cancel-safe two-phase sealing.
acceptance_criteria:
- All child beads closed with passing unit + integration tests and `spine-rules` conformance.
- Cold agent can orient, inspect, diff, twin-test, sandbox, and seal a receipt using one coherent CLI and `control.v0` grammar.
